title: Papercut
look: Layers of cut paper casting shadows on each other, stop-motion.

doc.essence: A paper diorama: each layer of the rig is a sheet of cut paper casting a shadow on the one below.
doc.notIt: Not flat (shadows between layers, stop-motion, paper grain).
doc.shapes: Every layer casts an offset shadow.
pitfalls: Many layers stack many shadows: keep layers few.
